purpose: Machine-readable inventory for negative security controls; absence of evidence remains a release blocker.

scenarios.control: Crash recovery is covered, but renderer/process isolation is not proven.
scenarios.evidence: In-process engine and missing adversarial process artifact block Stable.

scenarios.control: Versioned IPC, bounded payloads and caller-context fencing reject malformed or mis-scoped commands.
scenarios.evidence: Real Tauri command-adapter evidence is still pending.

scenarios.control: Request IDs, navigation generations and engine epochs fence stale events.
scenarios.evidence: Contract tests exist; a real Servo event-stream artifact is still pending.

scenarios.control: Navigation policy validates schemes, hosts, ports, redirects, rooted file paths and external handlers.

test.selector: navigation policy URL, redirect, traversal and handler corpus

scenarios.evidence: Engine-neutral control is tested; real Servo navigation integration remains a separate gate.

scenarios.control: Download broker enforces profile roots, filename/path safety, quotas, quarantine and interruption cleanup.

test.selector: traversal, ADS, device-name, collision, quota and interruption tests

scenarios.evidence: OS-specific executable marking and checksum evidence remain pending.

scenarios.control: Permission and prompt coordinators enforce exact origin/context/profile/tab scope, gesture and lifetime rules.

test.selector: origin-confusion, gesture, expiry, revoke and clear tests

scenarios.evidence: Hardware/engine permission adapter evidence is not present.

scenarios.control: Popup policy denies unsafe opener/cross-origin cases and bounds popup storms.
scenarios.evidence: Core negative suite covers gesture, origin, routing and storm limits.

scenarios.control: TLS, certificate and mixed-content policy must be delegated to the trusted engine/platform.
scenarios.evidence: No local TLS fixture or real Servo network artifact is available; do not claim coverage.

scenarios.control: Tauri origin, capability, CSP and caller-context controls constrain the privileged UI boundary.

test.selector: origin, window, iframe and generation negative cases

scenarios.evidence: Local shell controls are tested; page/process isolation remains unproven.

scenarios.control: Profile lock and OS permission/keychain policy must prevent local profile theft and lock bypass.
scenarios.evidence: No concurrent-process, keychain or backup artifact is available in this slice.

scenarios.control: Signed update metadata, channel/downgrade checks, revocation and last-known-good recovery are required.
scenarios.evidence: Updater implementation is outside the completed M4 slice.

scenarios.control: Fork workflows must be secretless, least-privilege and resistant to hostile reporter/artifact input.
scenarios.evidence: Workflow-hostile PR fixtures and enforcement identity are not yet proven.

scenarios.control: Lockfile, dependency policy and baseline secret checks reduce supply-chain exposure.

test.selector: git-source and secret-like text rejection tests

scenarios.evidence: Advisory, license, SBOM and provenance gates are not complete.

scenarios.control: Extensions remain outside the MVP until a capability/process boundary and manifest policy exist.
scenarios.evidence: No extension API is claimed or enabled.

scenarios.control: Diagnostics use an allowlist and redact URLs, tokens, paths and page content before local retention.
scenarios.evidence: Local bundle controls are tested; telemetry integration is not present.

scenarios.control: Watchdog, bounded restart, checkpoint retention and epoch fencing prevent unsafe recovery replay.

test.selector: crash, hang, restart, shutdown and stale-event tests

scenarios.evidence: Real engine crash/hang artifacts are still pending.

scenarios.control: Versioned session data and transactional journal preserve the last valid snapshot across interruption.
scenarios.evidence: Full profile migration matrix remains a downstream gate.

scenarios.control: External handlers require an explicit allowlist/confirmation and reject shell metacharacters.
scenarios.evidence: OS handler launching adapter is not present; policy-only evidence is not a launch claim.
